market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from $100 oil, inflation re-acceleration, and trade war escalation. Expect volatility with Dow/S&P/Nasdaq under pressure. Tech/AI provides partial support but valuation divergence (AMD-Nvidia) signals rotation. Apple event and Bessent debt buyback details are near-term catalysts. RBC's 10% decline warning warrants caution. Oil likely sustains $95-105 range.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure supercycle (power, chips, software) remains structurally bullish but faces valuation digestion. Energy transition accelerates with utility M&A and AI power demand. China slowdown pressures global growth. Social Security/fiscal risk is a 3-5 year overhang. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US-China) reshapes supply chains. Gold and energy remain strategic hedges. 6-12 month outlook: cautious with selective tech/energy upside.
